# third_party/z80

Z80 CPU emulator core used by the Z80 vessel (`src/vessel.c`).

- Origin: https://github.com/superzazu/z80
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)
- Vendored: 2026-11-17
- Files: `z80.c`, `z80.h`, `LICENSE`, copied verbatim, unmodified.

The core is C99 (`stdint.h` / `stdbool.h`); that is accepted for this
vendored code only. P8PBASIC's own sources stay C89-style.
